plant-based dining with a cozy atmosphere

The food is thoughtfully prepared with organic ingredients — we especially enjoyed the grilled eggplant, fresh rolls, and herbal teas. The service was warm and professional, and the whole experience felt nourishing and peaceful. A perfect spot for mindful dining in Hanoi.

Visited the cafe for brunch/lunch with my friend on our trip to Hanoi. 

Food was delicious - we tried the banana pancakes, vegan oatmeal, Hanoi rolls and stuffed tofu. Portions were extremely generous and we struggled to finish (but did so because it was so yummy!)

Juices were delicious also.

Banana crepe & hot coffee
Apr 2023 • Couples
Our mission for today was to find some vegan sweets and it was completed at this lovely place. 

Banana crepe was delicious, the mango cake and mixed nut chocolate cake - just OK. They probably were delicious when have been baked a few days ago. 
The Vietnamese coffee was strong and hot, as we requested.

If you have a sweet tooth then head to The Veg - organic vego & tea in Old Town. Just verify the freshness of the dessert you are ordering.

Would come back for the banana crepe and sit on the balcony for the best view of the town.
